theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (μHE[2].restrict (Q : Set (Euclid P))) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 2 → μHE[2].restrict (Q : Set (Euclid P)) {w : Euclid P | ‖w‖ < 3 ∧ |inner ℝ w a| < r ∧ |inner ℝ w e| < r} = ENNReal.ofReal (4 * r ^ 2) ∧ μHE[2].restrict (Q : Set (Euclid P)) {w : Euclid P | ‖w‖ ≤ 3 ∧ |inner ℝ w a| ≤ r ∧ |inner ℝ w e| ≤ r} = ENNReal.ofReal (4 * r ^ 2)
